missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Вариант' is the nominative as the predicate noun. 'Лучший' is the agreeing masculine adjective giving the evaluation.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Вариант' is the inanimate masculine accusative object of 'выбрали', identical to the nominative. 'Другой' is the agreeing adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Варианта' is the genitive after 'у', the option that has drawbacks. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative with dative. 'Вариант' is the accusative object of 'предпочитаю', while 'второму' is the dative of the rejected option. 'Первый' agrees with the object.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О варианте' uses the prepositional form 'варианте' after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional case.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'Вариантом' is the instrumental after 'с', the option agreed with. 'Этим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Варианта' is the genitive after 'без', marking the missing backup. 'Запасного' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantifier. 'Вариантов' is the genitive plural required by 'несколько'. The quantifier governs this counting form.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Варианты' is the nominative plural subject of 'кажутся'. 'Все' agrees with it, and 'хорошими' is an instrumental predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Варианты' is the inanimate accusative plural object of 'рассмотрели', matching the nominative plural. 'Все' agrees, and 'внимательно' adds the manner.
